_comment: Everything the wording or the link might need changing to lives in this file. Edit it in Notepad, save, then reload the app in the browser. No need to touch any other file.
_qr_url: The address of the Microsoft Form the vendor records vouchers in. The QR code for it is printed on Vendor instructions.pdf, not on the vouchers: the same code serves every voucher, so the vendor keeps one copy by the till. Printed at 45mm on that sheet, a long ResponsePage address is perfectly scannable, so there is no need to shorten it. Left as placeholder text, the vendor sheet prints with a note in place of the code.
holder_instruction: Hand this voucher to the vendor to redeem.
venue_warning: Not accepted anywhere else on campus, including the convenience store.
small_print: If the full value is not used, change will not be given.
One voucher per transaction. No photocopies.
